{{ModeInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:TheBeginningIcon.png]] |-|Full Icon = [[File:TheBeginningBanner.png]] |chapter = TDS: Origins |previous_mission = [[Brute Force]] |next_mission = [[Ghost Town]] }} ==Description== '''The Beginning''' is the opening cutscene for the first chapter of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. It happens before a [[Ghost Town]] match starts. ==Cutscene== [[File:TDS Chapter 1- The Beginning Cutscene|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
Five [[T.D.S. Organization]] members, that being the [[Commander]], [[Minigunner]], [[Soldier]], [[Sniper]] and Recruit are being driven to [[Abandoned City]] in a [[Gunner APC]] driven by an unseen Truck Driver. The [[Minigunner]] is sleeping while the others are just sitting on the seats. The [[Dispatcher]] informs the agents of their mission, which is finding any survivors in [[Abandoned City]], which after months of surviving in a zombie infested zone has finally fallen to the zombies. On the way there, the [[Gunner APC]] hits something, waking up the [[Minigunner]]. Eventually, they reach the location, where they are stopped by a zombie horde. They leave the [[Gunner APC]] then get into a fight with them.
===Script===
'''Script'''
[[File:TheBeginningCutscene.ogg|300px]]
''Cutscene starts inside the [[Gunner APC]], where the [[Minigunner]], [[Sniper]], [[Soldier]], [[Commander]] and Recruit are sitting on seats while music is playing.'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Your mission is to find the survivors and bring them back to base. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Eliminate the zombies as needed.
